ValidationRule.description: validation rule to lock down fields that are permanently editable at the profile level. Fields locked because of WinZone sourced data.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ISCHANGED(OwnerId) ), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Record Type, Owner, and Account Name cannot be edited. These fields are sourced from WinZone
